claims.statement: Enterprise runner-group organization access may allow selected organizations or all enterprise organizations. Only the ghes conditional states private-repository access by default with an override; configuration options are not permission grants.

Local actions resolve relative to the default repository workspace; a nondefault checkout location requires updating the action path. The example checks out the repository before referencing its action directory. Its tree and action.yml presence do not prove implementation behavior.

workflow_run branch filters constrain the triggering workflow's branch, not merely the receiving workflow's branch. Glob special characters require escaping for literal names; the examples use Build requested activity with releases inclusion or canary exclusion.

Branch inclusion and ignore keys cannot coexist for the same event. Ordered negative matches remove earlier inclusion and later positive matches restore it; the final releases/** then alpha exclusion example excludes main. Branch matching alone does not prove upstream success or trusted artifacts.

workflow_run workflow-name filters support glob syntax and escaping. Examples distinguish Build requested activity from completed Build* and escaped Build C++ names. Completed is not synonymous with successful; the linked legacy syntax path requires separate navigation reconciliation.

Event types narrows activity selection and permits an array; single-activity webhook events do not need this key. The label example selects created and edited but not deleted. The event reference remains separately reviewed evidence.
